questions.prompt: What must be on before you can use Research?
questions.explanation: The Help Center says you must have web search turned on for Research to function. Research also requires a paid plan.

questions.prompt: Research runs on Claude ____ 5.5, whatever model you selected for the chat.
questions.explanation: Research runs on Claude Opus 5.5 and falls back to Claude Opus 4.8 when needed, regardless of your selected model.

questions.prompt: Match each need to the right tool.

pairs.left: Hard reasoning that needs no new information

questions.explanation: Search handles quick facts, thinking handles reasoning, Research handles comprehensive gathering (5+ searches), and web fetch reads a specific URL.

questions.prompt: Which habits help you evaluate cited sources? Select all that apply.

options.text: Open the source and confirm it says what Claude claims
Prefer primary sources like official sites and original studies
Check whether the date matters and is current
Trust any claim that has a citation

questions.explanation: A citation only proves some page said something. Open it, prefer primary sources, check dates, and look for independent agreement.

questions.prompt: During Research on web or desktop, how does Claude treat your enabled connectors?

options.text: It can use their tools automatically without asking each time
It asks for approval before every single connector call

questions.explanation: During Research, Claude can use connector tools automatically without approval each time, so review which connectors are enabled first. On mobile, Research only searches the web.

questions.prompt: Order the steps for a trustworthy Research report.

items.text: Open key citations and re-check single-source claims
Write a prompt with scope, criteria, and preferred sources
Turn on web search and Research, then run it

questions.explanation: Check connectors (Research may use them automatically), write a scoped prompt, run it, then audit the citations.
